This scale sits in the codebook's legacy-items tables rather than the PROMIS bank sections, so it has its own re-derivation script. Independent corroboration of the code-to-text tie, using the data rather than the codebook: the canonical CES-D words items 4, 8, 12 and 16 positively and the other 16 negatively, the shipped stems put the positive wording at exactly those four numbers ('I felt that I was just as good as other people', 'I felt hopeful about the future', 'I was happy', 'I enjoyed life'), and in the live data those four are the only items that correlate negatively with the rest -- mean r against the other 19 of -0.29 to -0.13 against +0.22 to +0.34 for all sixteen others, with no overlap between the two groups. The shared instruction sentence is carried in instructions; the codebook gives no separate item context, so section_prompt is empty.
